e1.speaker: envoy_horn
e1.text: The last page, little blade. Your hands are so steady now. He will be proud.

e2.speaker: envoy_horn
e2.text: Do you know what waits at the end? Yourself. Kill it quickly. Don't look at its face.

choices.text: Why would it have my face?
You're not his envoys. You're what's left of the others he raised.
I saw the last page. I know what's under his mask.

e_obey.speaker: envoy_horn
e_obey.text: Good. Faces are such heavy things to carry.

e_why.speaker: envoy_horn
e_why.text: Every telling has a hero. He raised one of you in every world. Only one gets to finish the book.

e_truth.speaker: envoy_horn
e_truth.text: ...Clever. Too late, but clever. We wear our masks so he cannot see us cry.

e_page.speaker: envoy_horn
e_page.text: ...Then you know what we are, too. What's left of the others he raised. We wear our masks so he cannot see us cry.

post.speaker: envoy_horn
post.text: There. Now you are the only one left, little blade. He'll want you home. Go on... go home.
